text: The filters shall be sized for the maximum sea-salt aerosol event (165 ug/m3, DP-OWNR-0005) and the PM10 episode (260 ug/m3, DP-OWNR-0008) with a filter change interval of at least 6 months at the annual mean salt concentration (14 ug/m3, DP-OWNR-0006); each filter bank shall have differential pressure monitoring with alarm at 2 times the clean value and a bypass-free arrangement (sealed frames); the filters shall be accessible and replaceable without interrupting the pressurisation of the room (see redundancy).
